appStore.name: Shuuty
appStore.subtitle: Voice tasks & delegation
appStore.promotionalText: Say a task naturally. Shuuty recognizes the person, due time, and reminder, so you can delegate it instantly and keep every update in context.
appStore.description:
From idea to action.

Shuuty turns everyday agreements into clear next steps without moving context between notes, messengers, and calendars.

SAY WHAT NEEDS DOING
Record a task in your own words. Shuuty prepares the title and description, recognizes the due time, reminder, person, and place, and can split several thoughts into separate tasks for review.

DELEGATE IT RIGHT AWAY
Assign a task to a friend or group member. They receive it when you create it, while you can see what is waiting for acceptance, in progress, or complete.

KEEP THE FULL CONTEXT
Private, Received, and Delegated tasks have clear, separate views. Add subtasks, priorities, due times, reminders, and locations. Conversation and activity stay with the task.

ONE GROUP, ANY PURPOSE
Create a private circle, team, community, client space, calendar, booking flow, or public offer. Enable only what you need: chat, threads, tasks, calendars, bookings, and time logs.

MEETINGS AND DISCOVERY
Plan the place, time, and participants. Explore nearby meetings, public groups, and local offers on the map.

Start with Free. Optional Pro and Teams plans raise limits and unlock additional capabilities.

Terms: https://shuuty.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://shuuty.com/privacy/
appStore.whatsNew: Shuuty is ready for action. Create and delegate voice tasks with a due time, reminder, and location. Use refined Private, Received, and Delegated views, clearer groups, meetings, calendars, and notifications, plus better Pro and Teams plan management. This version also brings the new black-and-gold icon, more reliable syncing, and smoother recovery from temporary errors.
